title: [202205][snmp] `snmpd` not running after `config reload`
author: lolyu
body:

#### Description
`snmpd` is not running after `config reload`.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. `config reload`
2. `docker exec snmp supervisorctl status`


#### Describe the results you received:
`snmpd` is not running after `config reload`

#### Describe the results you expected:
`snmpd` should be running after `config reload`

comments.author: lolyu
comments.body: When the system is reloaded and `intfmgrd` is started, `intfmgrd` first flush all the loopback devices[1], then setup the new loopback devices[2]. If `snmpd` is started between [1] and [2], `snmpd` will fail to bind to the loopback addresses as the loopback devices are not created yet.

#### Why I did it
Fixes #16486

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: 24780690

#### How I did it
As `snmp` depends on `intfmgrd` to work, let's add a check to ensure `intfmgrd` is running.
The check will run for 20 seconds at most.

#### How to verify it
Do `config reload` and confirms `snmpd` is started after `intfmgrd` setups all the loopback interfaces.
